title: Drop and Border
author: Lena Thornbury
blurb: Sable Blackwood, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
